newsitem.title: UK: Nikko appoints new co-head of UK equities.
newsitem.headline: Nikko appoints new co-head of UK equities.

text.p: Nikko Europe Plc, an investment banking arm of Nikko Securities Co Ltd, said in a statement on Thursday, that Frederic Robert had been appointed co-head of the its equity trading division, effective immediately.
Robert, who will work alongside the current head Hiroshi Wakutsu, joins Nikko from Paribas Capital Markets in London where he was head of product development and research, global derivatives.
At Paribas, he was responsible for structuring fixed income and equity derivatives products, focusing on derivatives based balance sheet hedging strategies and structured assets.
